subject: Invoice INV-2026-001 from Acme Sh.p.k.
why: Subtotal 1000 + VAT 200 = 1200. The happy path: a row in the Invoices Log and a notification in the invoices channel.

subject: Invoice INV-2026-002 - Beta Consulting

observed.validation_note: subtotal + tax_amount does not equal total_amount

why: 500 + 100 = 600, but the document says 700. Proves ADR-0002: the row is still written, with needs_review set and a review alert. Note the model reports confidence 1.0 — it read the document correctly; the document is wrong. Only the arithmetic check catches this.

subject: Invoice discussion - meeting notes attached
why: Meeting notes, not an invoice. This was written expecting the ADR-0001 retry path — but gemini-2.5-flash returns a well-formed JSON object full of nulls rather than prose, so parse_ok is true and it is the confidence gate that catches it. The outcome is still correct; the mechanism is not the one intended. See the note on the retry path in the README.

subject: Fatura ne format teksti
why: text/plain is not in the Split Attachments allowlist, so Route by File Type sends it down the Unsupported slot. No Gemini call is made at all.

subject: Receipt from corner shop
why: A till receipt with no vendor id, no invoice number and no VAT line. This is the case that motivated ADR-0002: the missing tax is treated as 0, so the arithmetic closes and the receipt is logged clean rather than flagged. It was written expecting confidence below 0.6; the model returns 0.7, so it passes — which is the intended behaviour for a legitimate tax-exempt receipt.
